subject.title: Suppress failed tool progress in Discord

question: Should this Discord-visible suppression require retained live Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or log proof before merge, or will maintainers accept the unretained canary report as a proof override?
rationale: The external PR gate cannot independently verify the after-fix canary observation or fallback-warning behavior, but a maintainer may intentionally accept that proof gap.

options.title: Require retained Discord proof
options.body: Ask for redacted after-fix Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs before merge so the message-delivery behavior is inspectable.

options.title: Apply proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the operator-observed canary report and own the remaining fallback-warning uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require retained Discord proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted after-fix Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs before merge so the message-delivery behavior is inspectable.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete recently merged the latest Discord monitor change on this path and is a likely reviewer for the proof/merge-readiness call.
